tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The neutral ground everything else sits on.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus, inputs — anything lifted off paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and dark blocks, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, placeholder — on paper and paper-raised (6:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ultra
tokens.usage: The signature. Full-bleed brand fields, primary buttons, selected states. Fill only — text on it is on-ultra. On dark paper it holds 3:1 as a shape.

tokens.name: ultra-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything painted ultra; also the deep companion block in brand compositions.

tokens.name: ultra-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted ground: selected rows, info callouts, behind ultra-ink text.

tokens.name: ultra-ink
tokens.usage: Brand color as TEXT or icon: links, active nav, numbers you want noticed — on paper, paper-raised and ultra-soft (5.7:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: on-ultra
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ultra or ultra-hover fill (7.5:1 light, 6.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px paper-colored gap. Alias of ultra-ink so it clears 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on paper and paper-raised. Always paired with a word or icon, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, as text or icon on paper and paper-raised. Always paired with a word or icon.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One family, Geist (Google Fonts, hosted). Tight, heavy headlines; relaxed body.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero statements, usually on an ultra field. One per screen at most.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Everything you need, nothing you don't.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI: tables, form help text, secondary copy.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Geist Mono is the technical accent: labels, numbers, code.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, table headers. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Figures in tables and stats, so columns align.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Prefer the larger steps between sections — whitespace is part of the brand.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list-row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gutter, card padding on mobile, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and form groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding and the edges of brand fields.

radius.note: Mostly square. Corners stay small so color fields read as confident slabs.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Brand fields, hero bands, full-bleed sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and toggles only.
